query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS historic_cigarettes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  name_original VARCHAR(255),
  region VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  country VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  manufacturer VARCHAR(255),
  creation_year INT,
  status VARCHAR(50),
  format VARCHAR(100),
  has_filter BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  price_historical VARCHAR(100),
  tobacco_composition TEXT,
  intensity INT,
  character_description VARCHAR(255),
  dominant_notes TEXT,
  perfumery_score DECIMAL(3,1),
  perfumery_applications TEXT,
  perfumery_approach TEXT,
  tier INT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
